machine.name: GOV17_quorum-key-revocation-lifecycle
machine.description: Quorum key revocation, per rotation frame: halts and revokes while a signer key is compromised, the key rotation coordinator invalidates every parked continuation the revoked principal signed and prepares the rotated keyring, which parks for a review dwell, and a distinct human approves the rotation with clean keys and attested Sources.

inputSemantics: lane_quorum_integrity_ok (binary; fact: keyring Source: re_pki CRL plus signer keys, org units, dwell; partial): signer keys clean, diverse, dwell met
gate_source_slsa_attested (binary; fact: provenance attestation (verify-build-provenance.py today; SLSA/in-toto new); partial): Sources and builds are attested
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
invalidation_done (binary; aigov-key-rotation-coordinator completion via aigov.gov17.key-rotation-coordinator.completion): every affected parked continuation is invalidated
keyring_ready (binary; aigov-key-rotation-coordinator completion via aigov.gov17.key-rotation-coordinator.completion): the rotated keyring is prepared
coordinator_failed (binary; aigov-key-rotation-coordinator completion via aigov.gov17.key-rotation-coordinator.completion): the agent's step failed
lane_principal_distinct (binary; fact: lifecycle extension: approver != preparer and not an agent (T15); new): the acting principal is distinct from the preparer and human

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

rules.description: M-GOV-17 S1_RevocationTriggered → S2_RotationParked: [lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_approved=0 ∧ lane_stale=0 ∧ invalidation_done=1 ∧ keyring_ready=1]

M-GOV-17 S2_RotationParked → S3_KeysRotated: [lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_approved=0 ∧ lane_stale=0 ∧ invalidation_done=1 ∧ keyring_ready=1]{2} · [lane_quorum_integrity_ok=1 ∧ gate_source_slsa_attested=1 ∧ lane_approved=1 ∧ lane_stale=0 ∧ lane_principal_distinct=1]
M-GOV-17 S2_RotationParked → S2_RotationParked: [lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_approved=0 ∧ lane_stale=0 ∧ invalidation_done=1 ∧ keyring_ready=1] · [gate_source_slsa_attested=0 ∧ lane_approved=1]
M-GOV-17 S2_RotationParked → S_err_Overdue: [lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_approved=0 ∧ lane_stale=0 ∧ invalidation_done=1 ∧ keyring_ready=1] · [lane_stale=1]

interconnections.purpose: Hand the frame's QuorumKeyring to GOV15, its next consumer (agentic-workflow-contract.json W6); never infer a governance verdict from document content.

conversion.transitionRule: SURFACE_SPEC.md, Boundaries: where a K-line starts and ends
conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5

allowedActions: Invalidate continuations signed by the revoked principal.

frameInputs.lanes: input cells 2-7, written by the lifecycle (reserved)
frameInputs.facts: every other non-completion input, written into the clone's block by the lifecycle's frame source (GOV-R19)
frameInputs.completion: input cells 8..10, the step agent's completion
